body.x: TINTABLE participated in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its ski goggles with electrochrome lens technology.

Ski, a typical sport that can be enjoyedonly in winter, is a sport that requires protective equipment. Among them, skigoggles are the most important equipment to protect the eyes and secure theview. But, since lenses for day and night are different, two separate gogglesshould be prepared.
TINTABLE's ski goggles are equipped with an electrochrome lens to adjust the brightness of the goggles through voltage, so the eyes are protected safely with one goggle day and night.

This technology is mainly used for windows and windshields for cars, but with the excellent optical power, low energy requirements, and complete solidification of electrochrome, optical products such as glasses, goggles, and visors have been created.

Electrochromic lenses have different colorsdepending on the material, but TINTABLE’s lenses are shades of gray to createthe effect of sunglasses, and users can customize the visible light from 70% to20% to see the effect.
